g.text: One turn: all gates precede response release and memory commit
Global cap rejects excess work immediately.
Foreign sessions fail before any model call.
inspect exact candidate and original context
Always release slots; completed requests append metadata audit.
Three model calls on an ordinary successful turn.
No raw checkpoint or early token streaming.
InputEvidence.relevant rejects unrelated and mixed-topic requests.
